project_type: npm workspaces monorepo (shared/, backend/, frontend/, infra/) for an MLB postseason summary SPA + AWS serverless backend. Strict TypeScript, ESM throughout.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds in order shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra. Node not on PATH by default: prefix commands with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2).
test_framework: Vitest across workspaces (*.test.ts next to code; *.property.test.ts fast-check property tests; infra assertions in infra/test/stack.test.ts). Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra). 2) npm test (all workspaces, incl. fast-check + infra). 3) npm run test:e2e -w frontend (Playwright headless chromium; may need `npx playwright install chromium` once). 4) npm run synth (cdk synth, no AWS). Do NOT run cdk deploy; do NOT make live Bedrock or live MLB calls in tests (mock/fixtures).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. frontend/dist and backend/dist are build output (gitignored); cdk.out from synth is transient.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed (node_modules present). Baseline verified green at session start: `npm run build` and `npm test` both pass. If Playwright chromium missing: PATH=... npx playwright install chromium.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN_INTERNET (a one-off read-only curl of the real standings endpoint was used to confirm JSON shape). Tests MUST use fixtures, not live calls. No cdk deploy. Node must be put on PATH via the nvm prefix above.
contribution_requirements: Steering (.kiro/steering/*.md, inclusion:always) requires: incremental commits; keep build/test/synth/e2e green before done; spec-driven dev is a graded lesson so .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md must describe the system as actually built; both README.md and README.ja.md must stay truthful and in sync; add/update tests in the same change as behavior.
key_patterns: predict(series, bracket, winPct: WinPctMap = {}, accuracy) is a PURE function in backend/src/predict/model.ts that already blends a per-team strength signal from winPct (0.5 when a team absent) with series progress. BracketService.getPrediction (backend/src/service/bracketService.ts) currently calls predict(series, bracket, this.winPct) where this.winPct defaults to {} - THE WIRING GAP. MLB client (backend/src/mlb/client.ts) uses global fetch, no key, narrows response, throws MlbApiError on non-200. DynamoBracketStore (backend/src/store/dynamo.ts) caches by pk=BRACKET#<season>, numeric ttl ~15min, no-ops when TABLE_NAME unset. PredictionResponse union (shared/src/types.ts) has mode:'prediction'|'results'|'upcoming'; Prediction interface carries favoriteTeamId/favoriteWinProbability/narrative/model/generatedAt. Frontend PredictionPanel.tsx renders mode:'prediction' via PredictionResult; i18n in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts has EN+JA maps with a `prediction.*` key family and t(key, params). TEAMS map (shared) is keyed by MLB team id.
mlb_standings_shape: GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/standings?leagueId=103,104&season=YYYY returns { records: [ { teamRecords: [ { team: {id, name}, winningPercentage: '.580' (string), wins, losses, runDifferential, runsScored, runsAllowed } ] } ] } (6 division records). Early/no-standings seasons return empty/absent teamRecords.
infra_table: infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts: single DynamoDB table, partitionKey name 'pk' (STRING), PAY_PER_REQUEST, TTL on 'ttl'. STANDINGS#<season> works WITHOUT any infra schema change. Both lambdas already have grantReadWriteData on the table.
directory_structure: shared/ (domain types + season logic), backend/ (mlb client, aggregate, predict model, bedrock narrative, dynamo store, service, lambda handlers), frontend/ (React SPA, components, i18n, e2e), infra/ (CDK stack + stack.test.ts), .kiro/ (steering always-on, specs, hooks, agents), .agents/tasks/ (feature plans).
